tasks.title: Working from home (advantages and disadvantages)
tasks.prompt:
In many countries a large proportion of office work is now done from home rather than in a workplace.

tasks.title: Museums: entertainment or education
tasks.prompt:

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

What problems does this cause, and what measures could governments take to address them?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

tasks.title: Letter about a delayed order
tasks.prompt:
You ordered a piece of equipment from an online shop six weeks ago and it has still not arrived. You have contacted the shop twice and received no reply.

Write a letter to the shop's customer service manager. In your letter:

- explain what you ordered and when
- describe the attempts you have made to contact the company
- say what you would like them to do

Write at least 150 words. Begin your letter 'Dear Sir or Madam,'.

- say why you think they suit the role

Write at least 150 words. Begin your letter 'Dear Sir or Madam,'.
